normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter used only by _transfer for balance updates and checks
to is a parameter used only by _transfer for balance updates and checks
amount is a parameter consumed directly by _transfer arithmetic
sender is a parameter indexing reflection state inside the transfer variant
recipient is a parameter indexing reflection state inside the transfer variant
tAmount feeds the reflection arithmetic that performs the balance subtraction
account is a parameter used to update the blacklist and exclusion mappings
time is a parameter added to block.timestamp to compute _lockTime
contractTokenBalance is the local amount passed into swapAndLiquify
takeFee is the local flag controlling fee application in _tokenTransfer
overMinTokenBalance is the local flag gating the swapAndLiquify call
tTransferAmount is a local credited to the recipient in the transfer variant
rAmount is the local reflection amount subtracted from the sender balance
currentRate is the local reflection rate used to scale transfer amounts
unitBalance is the local per-unit ETH amount used to compute the marketing transfer
